name: name
doc: we share these based on the names, so make them unique

name: size_x
doc: How big the image is that we generate these from

name: size_y
doc: How big the image is that we generate these from

name: spawn_percent
doc: 0-1 - with what chance do we add a spawn point to a cave

name: cave_count_min
doc: generates caves n, where n = random(cave_count_min, cave_count_max) (range 0..200)

name: cave_count_max
doc: generates caves n, where n = random(cave_count_min, cave_count_max) (range 0..200)

name: do_beginning_paths
doc: if set, will do the paths that go down near the center of the image, used for setting up the caves to coal mines near where player starts

name: do_beginning_down
doc: if true, will do a hole straight down

name: surface_caves_count_min
doc: generates caves n from the surface, where n = random(surface_caves_count_min, surface_caves_count_max) (range 0..200)

name: surface_caves_count_max
doc: generates caves n from the surface, where n = random(surface_caves_count_min, surface_caves_count_max) (range 0..200)

name: cave_strength_min
doc: how strongly do we carve the cave
